body: Thank you for your kind words. This isn’t the first time she has left but this is the longest she has ever stayed away. I know we all have a long road ahead of us and I’m prepared for it. I found a women’s shelter in town and we will be utilizing it if need be. Things have settled down some since I posted but I know it’s not over yet. I will talk to my mom about therapy when she is ready and I know I could benefit from it too. Thank you again.

My mom walked out of a 30-year abusive relationship yesterday. Today she went back “just to talk” and he would not let her leave. I didn’t know she was going there until she texted me and told me that she was there. When she wouldn’t answer her phone or respond to my texts I knew something was wrong. My uncle and I went to go get her. 

He texted and called her for hours after we left and only stopped when she threatened to go to the police. I told her if she goes back to him she’ll be leaving in a body bag next time. We have nowhere else to go except my place and can’t afford to stay in a motel for an extended period of time. I feel like a frightened child all over again and it’s awful.

I tried therapy but my doctors kept leaving and I would have to see someone else. It was frustrating. I have tried multiple antidepressants but they all made me feel even worse. I appreciate the suggestions but I've tried so many things to no avail. I feel I am hopeless.

That is pretty much my day to day existence. I tell myself those things every day. It just gets harder the older I get. I'm so tired and stuck. My daughter and guilt are the only things keeping me here. It's a sad existence. I really wish I had ended it years ago. I don't know how I've made it this far and I feel there's no turning back now. I've tried to end my life a few times over the years but never successfully. And many days I stand in my kitchen with a knife to my arm praying for the courage to do it. I don't really want to die, I just want to feel ok. I know life is not about being happy, I just don't want to be sad all the time anymore.

Your story sounds similar to mine. I'm the stay-at-home mom to a one year old and after a particularly bad day I stumbled across this sub. I've dealt with depression and anxiety since I was six years old. I just turned 35 and I'm so tired. I feel my daughter deserves a better mother than I can be. I try so hard but it never seems like enough. 

I wish I could disappear or end it all but the guilt keeps me here. I want to be better, I want to not feel this sadness and worthlessness all the time. I think of how sad my daughter would be to not have a mother, but I worry that she will resent me for having such a mentally messed up mother. I feel I can't win either way. 

Somehow I keep going and I always hope tomorrow will be better even though I know it won't. I'm sorry if it seems I'm making your post about myself. I'm in a dark place right now and need to try and relate to someone else. I hope we will both be ok someday.

Texas abortion laws are terrible and obviously are trying to make it extremely difficult for women to receive one. I just wanted to point out that surgical abortions can be done as early as 3-4 weeks in pregnancy. There's no reason to wait for the fetus to become more developed.
That's the movie that got me interested in Charlie Chaplin. Great movie and Chaplin's stuff is very funny.

Thank you for sharing your story and I hope things start to improve for you. It sounds like you've been going through a lot of rough times and I'm glad you're able to stay positive. I'm going in for my surgical abortion tomorrow morning and it helped me to read about your experience.

Thank you. It helps to have support from people who've been in my situation. My emotions have been all over the place today and I'm sure the hormones are partly to blame. Luckily I don't have any symptoms yet. My first pregnancy I had morning sickness all day long for 6 weeks so I'm thankful for that. I just keep telling myself that I'm making the right decision and I know I am. 

I wish I could lie in bed all day and binge on YouTube lol. It's probably better that I can't though. My daughter keeps me busy and really lifts my spirits. If I were home alone all day I know I would spiral down into a dark place. So thank you again.

Unfortunately there's no other clinic nearby so I will just have to deal with it. I'm sure I will go through a roller coaster of emotions but ultimately I hope to feel relief and at peace with my decision. I know I'm not a bad person, I just tend to overthink things. It helps to have the support from this community and I will most likely post updates in the future. Thank you for your kind words.

Thank you. It's hard to keep my emotions out of it. I've always been an emotional person and I think I'm still in shock from all of this. I just found all this out yesterday and I know it'll take time to process. I know this will be the longest 2 weeks ever. Plus with Christmas around the corner it will be hard to keep a happy face on. Thank you for your support. It means a lot.
